title: ALMA Observations of Molecular Absorption in the Gravitational Lens PMN 0134-0931 at z = 0.7645
question: Do the lensing galaxies of PMN 0134-0931 at z=0.7645 show CO and HCO+ J=2-1 absorption along different lensed lines of sight, and what do the kinematics and column densities reveal about the molecular gas?

data.angular_resolution: nominal 0.35" (B3), 0.28" (B4); best continuum 0.24"x0.18" at 140 GHz uniform

what.value: Radio continuum component positions and flux densities (15 GHz, spectral index -0.69) used for lens comparison and covering factors

evidence.quote: The location and relative flux levels are taken from Winn & Keeton (2003).

what.value: OH 1667 MHz 4-component Gaussian fit and HI 21cm profile

evidence.quote: Kanekar et al. (2012) provide a 4-component Gaussian fit to their OH 1667 MHz spectrum

what.value: Lens model with two galaxies of similar mass

evidence.quote: The two lensing galaxies, called Gal-N and Gal-S in Keeton & Winn (2003), are of similar mass

recipe.method: Continuum images from continuum basebands; component fluxes and positions tabulated

recipe.goal: Extract absorption spectra and fit Gaussians
recipe.method: Spectra extracted with aperture equal to restoring beam toward A-C and D from Briggs cubes; Gaussian fits
key_parameters: Briggs robust 0.5; 3 Gaussians for D, 2 for A-C

recipe.method: tau = -ln(1-F); LTE column density from integrated opacity
1.0" aperture spectrum binned to 13.4 km/s; 5 sigma limit on H2 mass

answer_key.quantity: Velocity difference between A-C and D absorption

evidence.quote: The ratio of $N_{CO}/N_{HCO^+}$ is $\sim$500 towards the A-C component and $\sim$1500 towards the D component.

answer_key.quantity: 5 sigma upper limit on molecular mass

evidence.quote: the 5$\sigma$ upper limit to the molecular mass is $3.5 \times 10^{9}$ M$_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Phase calibrator and bandpass details beyond names; flagging
Continuum subtraction / how continuum level in line cubes was determined
Cell and image size, clean threshold, masking
Initial guesses and fitting code for Gaussian fits
Excitation temperature Tx used for column densities
Rest frequencies of CO and HCO+ used
missing_for_reproduction: Tx and rest frequencies for column densities
score_reason: Public ALMA project and clear recipe, but many processing and imaging details unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple spectra, numeric results in tables.
